errors.text_span: auf etwa 123 (um Jan. 2023) sowie auf etwa 141 (um Jul. 2023)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the dates of two major jumps for the purple line (Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn). The jump to ~123 occurs in July 2022 (not Jan. 2023), and the jump to ~141 occurs in October 2022 (not July 2023).

The dark blue line representing "Tarifliche Stundenlöhne" has a value of approximately 152-153 in January 2025, which is visibly higher than the purple line's value of 150 at the same time. Stating it is 'etwa 150' (about 150) is inaccurate and misses the fact that this line has overtaken the other.

The dark blue line ends at a value of approximately 155, but it does so before July 2025. The line stops roughly halfway between the 'Jan. 2025' and 'Jul. 2025' tick marks, so stating it ends 'um Jul. 2025' (around July 2025) is incorrect.
